reason: The plugin is primarily an interface navigation utility that helps users discover dsh-TUI shortcuts through a searchable, grouped cheatsheet panel exposed by the /keys command; this is directly evidenced by the README and package description. It operates as a local in-app helper without external integrations, and no broader automation, code-generation, or network-facing behavior is indicated.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 dsh-TUI 中提供 `/keys` 快捷键速查面板，以分组和搜索方式展示键位说明，帮助用户快速发现可用快捷操作。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a `/keys` shortcuts cheatsheet panel in dsh-TUI, showing grouped and searchable keyboard actions for quick discovery of available interface commands.

capabilities: Show a local keyboard shortcut panel in dsh-TUI
Search shortcut entries by key or description
Provide a grouped text fallback when scene-based UI is unavailable
